extensionDescription.message: Intercepts browser downloads and forwards them to the LGOM desktop client.

desktopClientHint.message: The desktop client is reached over its loopback port. When it is not connected, downloads fall back to the lgom:// URL.

interceptDownloadsLabel.message: intercept downloads and forward to LGOM

maxUrlLengthLabel.message: maximum URL length forwarded (core params only above this)

handoffDescription.message: hand-offs go over the local port first and fall back to $URL$ while the client is not running

handoffPageHint.message: Last-resort channel: used when nothing answers on the local port, i.e. while the LGOM client is not running. Leave it in the background; the extension reopens it when it is needed.

aboutDescription.message: forwards intercepted downloads to the LGOM desktop client via the $PROTOCOL$ protocol.
